subject: ventures/coi-expiry-gap-checker
auditor: agent session (Claude), see run record prompts/runs/ for 2026-11-28 quality/0
professional: a construction risk manager or GC compliance coordinator who tracks subcontractor certificates of insurance (ACORD 25) against contract insurance requirements

evidence.correctness: On arrival: renewal gaps now follow the 12:01 a.m. policy period (expires 2026-06-01, renewal effective 2026-06-02 -> '1-day gap'; Delta sample 2026-06-01 -> 2026-06-20 -> 19 days, counted by hand). Pollution, liquor and garage liability no longer satisfy GL. New high: normalizeCoverage('GL incl. products/completed ops') returned 'WC' and 'Products-completed operations' returned 'WC' because /comp/ matched 'completed' (calc.mjs:67 before the fix), so a GL row could satisfy the workers' comp requirement and leave GL 'nothing on file'. Renewal-on-file still produced a lead-time warning and a chase-list row (probe in run notes).
evidence.completeness: Claimed features checked by probe and Playwright: paste/CSV read, limits, umbrella offset, endorsements, lead time, renewal gaps, chase-list CSV, .ics export, both examples. All work end to end; ACORD 25 column headings were rejected ('No "coverage" column', 'No "expiration" column').
evidence.verification: node --test '*.test.mjs': 29 pass on arrival. Re-ran the four mutants that survived on 2026-11-12 with quality_mutate.py: all four still survived (umbrella >= shortfall boundary, 7-day error boundary, WC waiver, WC umbrella exclusion). Two others (gap > 0 -> > 1, dropping 'garage' exclusion) were caught.
evidence.craft: calc.mjs read in full. One pure module, tested separately from the page; .ics escape and folding now correct. Unhandled input remained in index.html: parseMoney failure -> 0 for every requirement and parseInt('')||0 for lead time, which silently switched checks off. Substring regexes in normalizeCoverage caused the WC misclassification.
evidence.claims: README 'Known gaps' listed the five open 2026-11-12 defects honestly; page FAQ renewal-gap wording matches the code (12:01 a.m. periods, verified by probe); page says WC waiver is checked and the code does check it (only untested). Disclaimer, privacy and 'no network' claims backed by page.test.mjs. No unbacked claim found.
evidence.fitness: Walked the coordinator's weekly job: load the list, check, send the chase list. A vendor whose renewal certificate is already on file still landed on the chase list as 'renewal soon', and a list typed with ACORD 25 headings was refused, both first-hour friction for this user.
evidence.domain: Compared with ACORD 25 (2016/03) layout and standard CGL/WC policy periods. Gap arithmetic and endorsement scoping (AI not on WC, waiver on WC) match practice. Departs: employers' liability disease limits (each employee, policy limit) not compared; coverage names matched by substring.

verdict: Not at the bar on arrival. PR #15051 closed 5 of the 10 defects from 2026-11-12 (both highs, the .ics escape, the README command and the UTC date) and wrote the other five down honestly; the blanket fix_prs reading had counted all 10 fixed. The re-audit found a new high: coverage names matched by substring, so a GL row mentioning completed operations was read as workers' comp. Correctness 2 and verification 2 (all four earlier surviving mutants still survived) bind. PR #19931 fixes the new high and four of the five open defects with tests that catch those mutants; employers' liability disease limits remain a known gap. Scores are before that fix; a later round re-audits.
